fix(delete-app): ArgoCD API call format + RBAC + non-blocking finalizer

Three production gaps surfaced during smoke testing on the live cluster:

1. ArgoCD's gRPC-Gateway returns 415 unless Content-Type is set on every
   call including DELETE; the PATCH endpoint also rejects application/json-
   patch+json bodies and expects an ApplicationPatchRequest wrapper with the
   JSON-Patch encoded as a string. argocd_client.py now sends the right
   headers and uses the wrapped body.

2. The platform-services ArgoCD account only had `applications, get/create`
   in its RBAC, so PATCH and DELETE both returned 403. seed.sh now adds
   `update` and `delete` (live config was patched out-of-band).

3. delete_app's add_finalizer step was fatal — if the patch failed for any
   reason, the actual cascade DELETE never ran. add_finalizer is now
   best-effort (logged warning on failure) and the API-level cascade DELETE
   is the primary cleanup path, so a finalizer-patch failure no longer
   blocks resource cleanup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push origin main
